lines.t: I was standing on the edge and slipping fast
All the heartbreak piling high and falling back
But you reached into my trembling
Said you'd hold me through the breaking
And you lifted me before I even asked
I was sinking, I was reaching
For a hope I couldn't find
But you caught me when I stumbled
Pulled me back into the light
now i'm falling into grace like the mercy in your name all the weight i carry fades
because you're holding me you're holding me i was drifting far away but you called me through
the waves now i'm rising because you stay and you're holding me you're holding me i'm falling
Calling into grace
Every burden that I laid before your feet
You turned ashes into something I can keep
Now the scars that once defined me
Are the stories you remind me
How your love can turn the broken into peace
I was sinking, I was reaching
For a hope I couldn't find
But you called me when I stumbled
